column7: A cited path absent from the complete diff and repository path sets cannot be a real citation.
A line beyond the recorded cited revision's complete line range cannot exist in that revision.
Set difference over declared criterion identifiers and recorded discharges cannot invent an uncovered identifier.
Equality of two recorded vendor identities against the recorded separation policy is a complete structural comparison.
Absence of a named rubric version from the complete tree at the recorded base commit is a repository fact.
A changed path outside every declared scope glob is a complete set-membership fact.
An APPROVED verdict and a recorded critical or high finding structurally violate their declared implication.
A BLOCKED verdict with neither a critical or high finding nor a criterion miss structurally lacks its declared justification.
A WARNING verdict with an empty complete findings set structurally violates its declared implication.
